name: notion-drive
description: A modern cloud drive service built with Rust + Next.js

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: cd backend && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && cd frontend && npm run lint
scripts.fmt: cd backend && cargo fmt && cd frontend && npm run format
scripts.clean: cd backend && cargo clean && rm -rf frontend/node_modules frontend/.next frontend/out
